name: mirage
text: CLV check done with no new API calls (tools/clv_consensus.py, notes in research/clv_audit_2026-10-21.md). Cross-checking sources lifts coverage from 27% to 37% of listed bets. Where two sources overlap they agree: PropLine's Pinnacle close vs SGO's Pinnacle close differ by a median 0.07 points (23 bets), so the Pinnacle CLV numbers are accurate; Novig-last-trades and DraftKings closes are about 10x noisier (0.75 points). Result on the 213 bets with a close: CLV +1.46% (standard error 0.48, 62% beat the close). The 159 settled bets whose closes agree made +1.8% ROI; the 35 settled bets whose closes could not be cross-checked lost 28%, mostly 5 NFL props (all lost) plus a few totals. So the CLV looks real and the losses so far are small-sample and concentrated in props, not a CLV error. Next: the engine itself keeps every close it fetches and marks each bet confirmed/unconfirmed (CH57 in TASKS.md).
